response.sql: WITH cust AS (SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS total FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId), overall AS (SELECT SUM(total) AS grand FROM cust), shares AS (SELECT c.CustomerId, c.total, c.total * 1.0 / o.grand AS share FROM cust c CROSS JOIN overall o), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_s FROM shares), above AS (SELECT s.total, s.share FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_s) SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_spent, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - (SELECT avg_s FROM avg_share)) AS avg_share_above_avg FROM above;
